syllabus_topics: SCADA systems for visualization of industrial processes. Basic functions, concepts, manufacturers, applications.
Connection of the SCADA to the control system. OPC and OPC UA.
Data acquisition algorithms at level PLC - SCADA. Buffers and algorithms for their management.
Overview of the main features of SCADA systems.
Graphic design of Human-Machine Interface (HMI). Graphical conventions and psychological patterns of the design HMI.
Cognitive ergonomics. Reliability of human-machine systems.
Evaluation of the HMI graphic design using the eye movement tracking method.
Operator panels, conception of their connection to the control system, Embodied Cognition
Data evaluation, industrial statistics and datamining.
Virtual startup and virtualization of PLCs and SCADA / HMI
Control applications design - methodology. Software tools for PLC programming, tasks dutiny controlled systems debugging and commisioning.
Advanced architectures of distributed control and computing systems DCS
Ethical and futurologic aspects of advanced automation in the context of Industry 4.0
